name: Codersly ERP: ERP for Small Business with HRM, CRM & Accounting
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly ERP is an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It helps small business owners, agencies, teams, and company admins manage basic HRM, CRM, and Accounting records from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Use Codersly ERP when you need a simple small business ERP plugin inside WordPress for employee records, departments, designations, leave requests, holidays, CRM contacts, companies, notes, tasks, customers, vendors, transactions, products, reports, settings, and CSV import/export tools.

The Free plugin includes practical admin screens for daily business management and shows clear Pro placeholders for advanced premium modules. Premium business logic is not included in the Free plugin.

Key Free Features

  • Admin dashboard for company management
  • Company profile and setup wizard scaffold
  • Basic HRM overview for small business employee management
  • Employee, department, designation, announcement, search, import, and export screens
  • Leave request, holiday, policy, entitlement, calendar, and report screens
  • CRM contacts, companies, groups, notes, tasks, and reports screens
  • Accounting customers, vendors, transactions, products, reports, and settings screens
  • Tools, settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens
  • Pro placeholders without premium business logic

HRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes basic HRM screens for employee management, departments, designations, announcements, leave requests, holidays, leave policies, leave entitlements, leave calendar, and HRM reports.

CRM for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes CRM screens for contacts, companies, customer groups, notes, tasks, and CRM reports so small teams can organize customer and company information from the WordPress admin.

Accounting for Small Business

Codersly ERP includes accounting screens for customers, vendors, transactions, products or services, reports, and settings. These screens are designed for simple admin-based business record management inside WordPress.

Premium Feature Placeholders

Premium placeholders include Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Accounting Reimbursements, Inventory, Purchase Orders, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Upgrade to Codersly ERP Pro for premium ERP features:
https://codersly.com/product/codersly-erp-pro-for-small-business-wordpress-plugin-license/

Who Is Codersly ERP For?

Codersly ERP is built for small businesses, startups, local companies, agencies, service providers, and WordPress site owners who want an admin-based ERP, HRM, CRM, and Accounting system without leaving WordPress.

Data Preservation

Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP file from the WordPress admin.
  2. Activate Codersly ERP.
  3. Go to Codersly ERP in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Start with Company setup, then add HRM, CRM, or Accounting records as needed.
sections.faq:
Is Codersly ERP an ERP for Small Business?

Yes. Codersly ERP is designed as an ERP for Small Business plugin for WordPress. It provides admin-based HRM, CRM, and Accounting screens for basic business record management.

Can I use Codersly ERP as a small business ERP plugin in WordPress?

Yes. You can use Codersly ERP to manage basic employee, leave, CRM contact, company, customer, vendor, transaction, product, report, and settings records from the WordPress admin dashboard.

Does the Free plugin include license activation?

No. License activation belongs to Codersly ERP Pro. The Free plugin does not create a License menu.

Does the Free plugin contain Pro business logic?

No. The Free plugin only displays upgrade placeholders for Pro features. Premium business logic is kept in Codersly ERP Pro.

Which Pro features are shown as placeholders?

The Free plugin shows placeholders for Payroll, Attendance, Assets, Recruitment, Documents, Training, Performance, Approvals, Org Chart, Employee Frontend Portal, CRM Deals, CRM Automation, Email Sync, Inventory, Purchase Orders, Advanced Reports, Audit Logs, White Label, and Integrations.

Does Codersly ERP delete my saved data on uninstall?

No. Codersly ERP Free does not delete saved HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, or Settings data when the plugin is deactivated, uninstalled, or deleted. Single-record archive actions are soft-delete; Delete All clears the selected table.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Shortened the readme short description to stay within the WordPress.org 150-character limit.
  • Improved readme keywords and descriptions for ERP for Small Business, small business ERP, HRM, CRM, and Accounting discovery.
  • Removed the Accounting admin helper/debug text shown above the Accounting tabs.
  • Fixed Free-to-Pro embedded admin rendering so Pro Add New/Edit screens keep native form, input, select, option, textarea, button, datalist, nonce, and hidden fields.
  • Fixed Pro dropdown fields appearing as joined text such as SelectActiveDraftFinalizedPaidClosedInactive when rendered through the Free admin shell.
  • Improved Free placeholder routing to the matching Pro HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, Tools, Settings, Reports, and Advanced Permission screens.
  • Kept premium feature implementation out of the Free plugin; Free screens remain placeholders/upsell holders only.
  • Added compatibility for Codersly ERP Pro 1.0.2 module rendering.

1.0.1

  • Initial WordPress.org submission as Codersly ERP.
  • Added admin HRM, CRM, Accounting, Company, Settings, CSV import/export, and Pro placeholder screens.
  • Added nonce verification, permission checks, prefixed hooks/options/namespaces, escaped output, changelog, and POT file.
